changelog: - **A Gate fed by two or more Pool lines no longer passes on more than it took.** A Gate that takes from Pools through several connections worked out how much it could carry from everything those Pools held, then took no more than each connection’s own amount, and still sent the larger figure on. With Pool A at 100 and Pool B empty, “5” from each, it took 5 and delivered 10: the model’s total went from 100 to 105 in one step, with no notice. Two “5” connections off one Pool of 8 delivered 10 as well. Each connection now brings at most its own amount, connections off one Pool share what that Pool holds, in their order, and the Gate passes on exactly what it took. The Gate’s state in the step report follows the same rule: for the two connections off a Pool of 8 it reads 8 available and short of supply, where it read 10 available and short of room. A “pull all” Gate still moves nothing when one of its connections is short. None of the bundled examples has such a Gate, so none of them changes. Because the engine’s numbers change for documents that do, a Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 8).
